regressions.incident: The 99-file DreamWorkspace modularization (commit 8636c7bb5b) left loadPhase02MediaGate unexported and memoryByKeysDocuments unimported. @ts-nocheck hid both from tsc; no consumer executed the component. The workspace rendered a blank page, and the residue board's extract handler swallowed its ReferenceError and stayed empty, dropping video/audio cards the user expected. The same session's board also dropped video/audio cards: the pinned-key ordering plus web-result mixing plus recall variance crowded them out of the 12-card cut; replaced by stratifiedMemorySample. That half is guarded by the retained live case residue-board-media-mix-live (its oracle fails whenever any of image/video/audio is absent); no deterministic single-line defect reproduces the old crowd-out, so it carries no separate fail_before_fix record.

fail_before_fix.proof_note: Reinjects the unexported loadPhase02MediaGate into a temp copy of ui/src; the render guard must fail against it and pass on current code. Exits non-zero if the guard is vacuous.

regressions.detected: 2026-08-19 live session; user reported missing pipeline steps and missing video/audio on the residue board.
